title: Dashrath Rupsingh Rathod v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Dashrath Rupsingh Rathod v. State of Maharashtra, (2014) 9 SCC 129
content.holding: Led to the Negotiable Instruments (Amendment) Act, 2015 inserting Section 142(2), which codified that jurisdiction lies where the payee delivers the cheque for collection through their bank account.
content.relevance: Territorial jurisdiction benchmark for filing Section 138 complaints.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India (2014) 9 SCC 129; 2014 INSC 534; Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act territorial jurisdiction.
